title: Here’s Why Index Funds Are Missing Out on Gains | Dimensional
gist: Thin podcast-episode blurb (Episode 61, The Informed Investor): Dimensional says index funds carry hidden costs around index reconstitutions and promotes a diversified strategy that rebalances daily.

insights.claim: Dimensional argues index funds have low fees but not necessarily low costs, citing hidden costs tied to this year's index reconstitutions.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: Fee ratio understates total cost of passive index exposure; compare implicit trading costs.
insights.quote: Index funds have low fees, but not necessarily low costs.

insights.claim: Dimensional proposes a diversified strategy that looks to rebalance every day as a better option than periodic index reconstitution.
insights.speaker: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
insights.so_what: Promotional framing from an active-systematic manager; treat as product positioning rather than evidence.

source_meta.author: Featuring Mark Gochnour, Head of Global Client Services Group
